title: Chapter 1881: Yang-Aspiring (I)

Chapter 1881: Yang-Aspiring (I)

After seeing his junior off, Li Ximing flew back on a streak of light. Upon reaching the solitary mountain, he found the young man already waiting quietly in the temple and smiled.

"You seem quite at ease, Nanwu."

Guo Nanwu had been tasked with holding off the demon king of White Rock Temple on nearby Fangyazhou, not far from where Li Ximing and Li Zhouwei had fought. He seemed to have managed the task effortlessly, showing no signs of exertion.

He smiled. "I have mastered [Severing Evil Pursuits], a Lesser Yang art for traversing Yin. It makes escape exceedingly easy, no less so than Valley Water. That demonic creature cultivates [Mansion Water] and could not hold me."

Having secured what he needed for the green talisman, Li Ximing was in excellent spirits. "I obtained quite a haul myself!"

They went inside together. Daoist Master Daomian approached them and sighed. "Only now do I understand the might of Jiangnan's Immortal Dao!"

These Purple Mansion Realm cultivators hid in this sparsely inhabited Western Sea precisely to enjoy the freedom their divine abilities afforded and keep themselves alive. How could they be insensitive to such events? Li Ximing knew they all saw their own possible fate in Shehu's downfall. Even someone like Daomian, who did not bear a grudge against him, could not help feeling troubled.

He replied, "Senior Liu has shown my family great kindness. We merely wished to rid him of a lingering concern! Besides, possessing a treasure can itself invite disaster!"

Though Baoxiang's expression remained composed, she too looked askance. "Tonight, the King of Wei's fearsome reputation will spread throughout the Western Sea!"

Li Ximing chuckled and shook his head, leaving the subject there. He said, "May we speak privately?"

Baoxiang looked up and accompanied him into the inner hall. Li Ximing smiled and asked, "I recall that you cultivate Pit Water. Is your Dao lineage complete?"

She raised her head with keen interest, her eyes lighting up. "Few Purple Mansion Realm Dao lineages in the world dare claim to be complete. Mine has been supplemented generation after generation and possesses a substantial inheritance. [Pit Water] is also a Dao lineage found throughout the world, yet we still lack [Man On Creek], which is in Jiangnan... If you possess that technique, senior, I would be indebted to you for helping me attain the Dao!"

"Well..."

How could Li Ximing not know that renowned divine ability? During his family's early rise, it had frightened them into suspecting danger everywhere.

He shook his head with some embarrassment and replied, "As for [Man On Creek]... I can only suggest that you inquire in Cangzhou. Whether you obtain it will depend on your own fortune... But I do have an art called [Water-Regulating and Mound-Transforming]."

He took out a profound slip of purple jade and handed it to Baoxiang. After reading its outline, she smiled. "What an ingenious art... This is... a method of Douxuan!"

The art had come from the [Upper Firmament Pavilion]. How could it be ordinary? Though Baoxiang did not appear particularly excited, Li Ximing knew she coveted it. He merely smiled at her identification of its origins, then said, "First, you have helped us greatly throughout this journey. I cannot leave Senior Liu indebted to you without repayment... Second, I would like to exchange it for the [Clear Profound Coffin] in your possession."

Naturally, Li Ximing had come for the [Clear Profound Coffin]. Having already obtained Yinxin's portion, he saw no need to pay dearly for Rogue Cultivator Yú's when he could trade with Baoxiang here. With such a favorable bargain before her, she barely hesitated.

"Agreed!"

One gained something for nothing, while the other privately believed she had found a bargain. They readily agreed and exchanged their items. Wearing a faint, ambiguous smile, Li Ximing asked, "What is Rogue Cultivator Yinxin's background?"

Baoxiang paused, then answered, "He came to cultivate in the Western Sea over a hundred years ago. He is powerful, and quite a few people have suffered at his hands... As for his particular Dao lineage, he only calls himself a rogue cultivator."

"Is something...?" Li Ximing smiled and shook his head. "Just idle curiosity."

He did not linger, stepping outside as he spoke. "There is something I would like Senior Daomian to examine!"

He spread his sleeve and brought out the [Supplementary Court Verdant Profound Cauldron], handing it to Daoist Master Daomian. Then he took out the three portions of [Clear Profound Coffin] and smiled. "Please take a look!"

Any Daoist Master who reached the Purple Mansion Realm possessed some shrewdness. It only took Daomian to understand Li Ximing’s arrangements. "This treasure of yours is extraordinary, fellow Daoist. Nowhere outside Jiangnan could one find something so wondrous!"

The [Supplementary Court Verdant Profound Cauldron] had come from [Wanlin Heaven], a grotto heaven of the Douxuan Dao, and was naturally exceptional. Li Ximing watched with a smile as Daomian gathered his divine ability and took a round disk from his sleeve.

The palm-sized disk shone like silver. Daomian collected a wisp of the [Clear Profound Coffin]'s aura, then took out several kinds of Foundation Establishment Realm water and fire.

After testing them one by one, he said, "This spirit artifact is rooted in [Gathering Wood], yet possesses the capabilities of [Whole Pill]. Its creator's ingenuity is beyond me. As for this [Clear Profound Coffin], it lies at the intersection of Water and Wood but lacks an aspect of Earth Virtue. Judging by my years of cultivation, it should be [Treasure Earth], with its power to nurture new life."

He smiled and said, "I will spend a few days calculating it carefully and make certain nothing is overlooked."

Startled, Li Ximing asked, "[Treasure Earth]? We need to supplement it with a spirit material? Senior, I would have made a grave mistake without your help!"

Daoist Master Daomian nodded. "This spirit artifact is extremely powerful. Even without that aspect of Earth, its mystic should still be able to condense spirit water... But the result would have inherent deficiencies and diminished mystics. If you encountered opponents of the Three Shamans and Two Zhus[1], Whole Pill, Banished Essence, or similar paths in battle, they might destroy the spirit water outright... Keeping it for use within the family would be less of a concern."

Li Ximing felt inwardly relieved after hearing this, then sighed. "But as for a Treasure Earth spirit material..."

After listening, Guo Nanwu smiled. "I have a portion of [Rock-Repelling Soil]."

Li Ximing had no desire to run around searching for another spirit material. Delighted, he took a [Manifest Shore White Blossom] from his robes. "Thank you for coming all this way. This [Manifest Shore White Blossom] is a Lesser Yang spirit material, perfectly suited to you. Take it for your use."

Though both were spirit materials, the [Manifest Shore White Blossom] could be consumed or put to other uses, and it matched Guo Nanwu's lineage perfectly. It was undoubtedly an excellent treasure. The young man's eyes curved with his smile as he cupped his hands. "Thank you for your generosity, senior!"

With everything settled, Li Ximing was even more pleased. He finalized the details with Daoist Master Daomian and silently took stock.

We've divided Shehu's belongings, but both the spirit artifact and the spirit embryo went to Zhouwei. Add the spirit item [Supreme Eave Brilliance] and the two spirit materials, [Dao-Gazing Scales] and [Manifest Shore White Blossoms], and our gains are tremendous, far beyond expectations!

And that is before counting the green talisman and the spirit water!

————

The sky was purple and gold even as its splendid light dimmed into the darkness of night.

While Li Ximing gathered spirit items and counted their gains in the Western Sea, unable to contain his joy, the black-robed young man hurried back to Moongaze Lake with cold suspicion in his heart. Landing within the great formation, he counted the days. He had only been away for half a month.

Rather than first seeking out Sima Yuanli, he went straight to the deepest part of the formation. He brought out the treasured urn and placed it on a table with his divine ability. Standing with his eyes lowered and his hands behind his back, he gradually loosened its mystics.

At that slight release, the vertical patterns on the urn lit up one by one, and it trembled faintly. Dense gray qi swirled at its mouth, then froze upon meeting the golden eyes in the darkness.

A quiet voice spoke. "This lowly creature greets the King of Wei..."

Now that he was completely imprisoned in the urn, Shehu sounded surprisingly calm. Golden light gleamed in the dark hall as Li Zhouwei asked evenly, "The [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant]. Where did it come from?"

The demonic creature within the urn fell silent for a moment, then spoke through gritted teeth, his voice full of hatred. "You found my treasure so quickly. So Yinxin did bring you there... Good... Good..."

1. Three Shamanic Dao refers to Xiukui/Merging Owl, Supreme Shaman/Shamanic Talisman Dao, and Jade True. Two Zhus refers to Hengzhu and Azure Manifestation. ☜
